events.headline: TRUMP SUGGESTS RENAMING STRAIT OF HORMUZ AS TRUMP STRAIT AMID IRAN WAR
events.detail: Despite renewed fighting with Iran and near daily attacks on ships, Trump says Strait of Hormuz is 'under USA control'.

events.headline: SAUDI ARABIA CONDEMNS DEADLY IRANIAN ATTACK ON TANKER IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Regional neighbours condemn attack this week that killed two crew members from the Philippines.

events.headline: IRANIAN ATTACK ON SAUDI TANKER KILLED TWO FILIPINO SAILORS, SAUDI ARABIA SAYS
events.detail: The kingdom condemns the targeting of Sidr, which was reportedly hit by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.

events.headline: ZELENSKY SAYS AIRLINES SHOULD AVOID RUSSIAN AIRSPACE AS UKRAINE ESCALATES DRONE
events.detail: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

events.headline: TÜRKIYE SUMMONS KIEV’S ENVOY OVER ATTACKS ON BLACK SEA SHIPPING
events.detail: Ankara has summoned Kiev’s envoy after two Turkish-operated vessels were attacked in the Black Sea Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: TRUMP HAS ‘HORMUZ SCHIZOPHRENIA’ – IRAN
events.detail: Trump apparently suffers from delusions as he speaks of the Strait of Hormuz as being a US territory, a senior Iranian diplomat has charged Read Full Article at RT.com
